en:01KS1AVRZN0YJD2T58NDDDY9CH.body: Full Burst RPG —BrownDust2. Routine maintenance and updates are scheduled for March 11th. Please refer to the details below. * All dates and times shown in this notice are in UTC. ■ Maintenance Schedule: March 11th, 11:50 PM - March 12th, 05:30 PM (UTC). (5 hr 40 min) ■ Effect: Game access unavailable ■ Details:  1. Story Pack 20 "Into the Abyss" Update - Story Pack 20, "Into the Abyss" will be added. Story Justia finally sets foot in the Night World. Together with Liberta and Blade, who have newly joined her journey, Justia discovers a sinister exhibition hall in Taros, the land of the undead in the Night World. Inside the hall lies hidden information about the Master of Dreams, a being that threatens both the Night World and the surface. Realizing this, Justia and her companions venture inside... In the pitch-dark exhibition hall, a deep abyss awaits them. - Story Pack 20 will be unlocked after completing Story Pack 19, "Forgotten War". *The skill balance of "temporary companions" who join during the pack may differ from the balance of "permanent companions" when the official companion released. 1-1. Full Voice Acting Support - The Main Quests of Story Pack 20 have full voice acting in both Korean and Japanese. - You can enjoy the main story of the new Story Pack with full character voice acting. 1-2. Night World World Map - With the addition of the Night World area in Story Pack 20, the World Map will be added. ㄴ After entering the world map in the Story Pack, you can switch to the Night World area by tapping the “Night World” tab on the left side. 2. Story Pack 20 Slice of Life Stories Added - Slice of Life stories for characters related to Story Pack 20 will be added. - Discover different sides of the characters through these Slice of Life stories. - Slice of Life stories can be viewed in the Slice of Life tab within the Story Menu on the Home screen. 3. Season Event "Psyche Artist" Update - The Season Event "Psyche Artist" will be updated. - Event Period for "Psyche Artist": After March 11th maintenance - Before March 25th maintenance. - You can participate in the Psyche Artist Season Event by tapping the "Season Event" logo on the right side of the home menu. - Psyche Artist Season Event consists of the following activities: Event Story / Normal Battles / Challenge Battles / Fiend Hunter / Event Shop. - You can purchase various items at the event shop with event currency acquired from each content. 1) Psyche Artist Season Event Story Story Mamonir, the ruler of Taros who governs the undead, discovers an undead named Palette in the Primordial Swamp. Impressed by her artistic talent, Mamonir decides to have Palette work as a painter in the exhibition hall. Palette longs to freely express her own world through her paintings, while Mamonir seeks to keep her under control. As a result, small cracks begin to form in their relationship. As tensions between the two slowly grow, unknown enemies invade Taros—and their fractured relationship begins racing toward an end that can no longer be undone. - Each episode unlocks sequentially as you watch them, and some episodes will be opened after a set period. 2) Psyche Artist Season Event Battle Guide - Event battles are divided into easy-to-challenge normal battles and challenging battles that require consideration of growth and strategy. - Upon entering the battle screen, you can check the recommended combat power for each stage, your current account's combat power, challenge objectives, and rewards for completing objectives. - Use the buttons at the bottom of the battle entry screen to check monster information or enter the battle. - Clearing each stage and completing challenge objectives will reward you with event currency. - Entering a battle requires AP. Free AP is charged every day at 12 AM, and you can purchase additional Paid AP with Dias in the event shop. - Winning a battle reduces AP by 1, and you receive rewards. If you lose or forfeit, AP is not consumed. - If you complete all challenge tasks in a particular stage, you can use the quick battle feature for that stage, instantly obtaining the rewards. - In cleared stages, you can proceed with Repeated Battles, gaining rewards with each victory. 3) Fiend Hunter Guide - The preparation period for hunting the giant monster "Abyssal Moon Shadow Tanya (Darkness)" will be opened. - You can access Fiend Hunter by tapping the "Fiend Hunter" button at the bottom of the main Season Event screen. - Fiend Hunter Hunting Preparation Period: After March 11th maintenance - March 18th 11:59 PM. - Fiend Hunter Hunting Period: March 20th, 12:00 AM - March 25th, 02:59 PM. Abyssal Moon Shadow Tanya (Darkness) Can you truly be trusted...? That there exists a life that, having never been born, met only death—and became a vengeful spirit, drenched in sorrow. That this twisted spirit has been parasitically dwelling within the soul of an innocent girl all along. Now, the lurking shadow of darkness awakens, surging forth like black lava, ready to engulf everything in ruin. And then... in the very moment you let your guard down, thinking you're safe, you'll find yourself caught in the shadow's trap— writhing in excruciating pain, unaware of when or how it all began. 4) Psyche Artist Event Shop Information - You can purchase various items in the Event Shop using event currency obtained from each content. - The main items for sale in the Event Shop are as follows: * In addition to the above products, various items necessary for growth will be available. - The Paid AP purchased in the Event Shop will reset once the Season Event ends. Please use all remaining AP before the reset. - The Event Shop will remain open for 14 days after the Psyche Artist season event ends, during which you can purchase items using remaining event currency. * Magical & Lyrical season event shop currently in progress will remain open for 14 days after the event ends. You can use any remaining event currency during this period to claim rewards. 5) Season Event Bonus Costumes - If you possess the event costume designated for each Season Event, you can obtain additional event currency at a certain rate from specific Season Event content. - The costumes eligible for bonuses during the season event from March 11th to March 25th are as follows: - If you own multiple costumes that grant participation bonuses, the additional event currency amounts will be combined and rewarded based on the number of costumes owned. 4. New Fated Guest Update - Retired Legend Olivier will be available as a Fated Guest at the Glupy Diner after the March 11th maintenance. - Obtain Retired Legend Olivier's contact information to engage in GluTalk and Encounter Events, build affinity, and unlock Special Interaction! - Please enjoy the full charm of Retired Legend Olivier through the story! * Fated Guests will only appear in the Glupy Diner Pack if you own the corresponding costume. 5. Fantasia Square Additional Update - To celebrate the 1,000th day, Fantasia Square will be transformed into a lantern festival atmosphere. - New content will also be added within Fantasia Square. 1) Catch the Yuridori - Event Period for "Catch Yuridori": After March 11th maintenance - Before March 25th maintenance.  - The “Catch Yuridori” event will start when you enter Fantasia Square every hour from :00 to :10. - After entering the square, catch as many Yuridori as possible within the time limit. ㄴ The “Catch Yuridori” event will begin after a short countdown upon entering the square. - There is no participation limit, but the rewards obtained from catching Yuridori have a daily limit, which resets every day at 12:00 AM. - The “Catch Yuridori” event is conducted individually for each player. Yuridori that are not caught will disappear once the time limit ends. - A total of 12 Yuridori will appear: 10 Normal Yuridori and 2 Special Yuridori. - Details regarding Yuridori capture and the rewards for the “Catch Yuridori” event are as follows. 2) Field Event: Pummel Statue - Event Period for "Pummel Statue": After March 11th maintenance - Before March 25th maintenance. - Two new interactive statues, the Jun-hee Statue and Jongho Statue, will be placed to the right of the fountain in the center of Fantasia Square. - When you approach the statues, interaction becomes available. Selecting the interaction will switch you to hit mode, where you can hit the statues. ㄴ When entering hit mode, movement will be restricted within a certain range. To move freely again, you must exit hit mode using the exit button. - Upon entering hit mode, you can check the number of hits you have made and the total cumulative hits by all users on the server. 3) Fireworks - Event Period for Fireworks: March 17th, 12:00 AM - Before March 25th maintenance. - To celebrate the 1,000th day, fireworks will be held at Fantasia Square at scheduled times. ㄴ Fireworks will occur every 3 hours. Please refer to the schedule below for the start times. - Upon entering Fantasia Square, you can check the Fireworks Guidance. Clicking the quest will automatically move your character to a location where you can view the fireworks. - Once you arrive at the designated location, an interaction icon will appear, allowing you to watch the fireworks. ㄴ The interaction icon will appear above the Mount button in the bottom-right corner. ㄴ After interacting and the screen transitions, character and camera controls will be disabled. - By interacting with the Fireworks button, you can obtain the following rewards once: - Enjoy the fireworks and celebrate BrownDust2’s 1,000th day together! 4) ID Display Option - An ID Display option will be added when entering Camera Mode in Fantasia Square. ㄴ While in Camera Mode, the feature can be turned on/off through the “Show ID” UI in the top-right corner. 5) New Avatar Update - Robin Hood Zenith will be added as a new avatar. ㄴ This avatar can be purchased with Deco Coins in the Avatar Shop. - The Stranger Bunny Zenith skin outfit will be added. ㄴ This skin outfit is automatically obtained when you acquire the “Stranger Bunny Zenith” Prestige Skin through Lucky Draw. ㄴ If you already own the “Stranger Bunny Zenith” Prestige Skin, the skin outfit will be automatically granted after the update. - New outfits and Accessories will be added to the Avatar Shop. 6) Avatar Costume/Skin Tab Added - A Costume/Skin tab will be added to the Avatar Settings, allowing each character’s costumes/skins to be grouped together for purchase and equipping. 6. New Battle Content “Taros Tactical Manual” Update - The first season of the new battle content, “Taros Tactical Manual,” will open. 1) Taros Tactical Manual System Guide - Taros Tactical Manual is unlocked after clearing Story Pack 1 (Normal difficulty) and can be accessed through the “Tactical Manual” UI on the right side of the Home menu. - Each season of Taros Tactical Manual lasts 4 weeks, and every season provides a bingo board composed of different stages. - The content features three difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, and Hard. Players select stages of their choice and complete battles to fill the bingo board. - In Taros Tactical Manual, battles must be fought using the designated starting SP, turn-based SP recovery, and only the temporary allies provided for each stage. - Upon winning each battle, players will receive a small amount of Gold as a clear reward depending on the difficulty, and one bingo tile will be completed. 2) Mission Rewards - By completing Taros Tactical Manual missions, you can obtain Gold, Refining Powder, Stickers, and more. - The mission and reward details are as follows: 7. Stranger Bunny Zenith Interaction Improvements - Some interaction motions for the Prestige Skin “Stranger Bunny Zenith” will be modified and newly added. - The climax scene from the interaction sequence of the Prestige Skin “Stranger Bunny Zenith” will be improved so that it can be applied as a special effect on the Home screen. * The addition of climax Home screen effects for other previously released Prestige Skins will be applied when those Prestige Skins are rerun. ㄴ For users who already own the Zenith Prestige Skin, the climax scene must be played once again after the update in order to obtain the special effect. - The obtained effect can be applied in Home Screen Settings → “Affinity Effect & Interaction.”   8. Story & Character Lore Adjustments (Phase 1) - Certain Hansen-related scenes in Story Pack 18 will be removed. - The chronicle related to Hansen will be revised. - The settings for Eclipse’s exclusive gear will be adjusted. - Some profile content for “Dimension Witch Eclipse” will be revised. - Some profile content for “Dream Bride Eclipse” will be revised. - Some profile content for “The Curse Celia” will be revised. - Some profile content for “Faithful Wings Olivier” will be revised. ※ A second phase is planned for the future. Further details will be announced in a later notice.   9. Removal of Season Event “Going Home” Story and Related Items - The Season Event “Going Home” story replay will be removed. - Home screen setting items related to “Going Home” will be retrieved and deleted. ㄴ If any “Going Home” related item is set on the Home screen, it will be replaced with the default Justia screen after the update. - “Going Home” related ID card items will be removed. ㄴ If your ID card is decorated with “Going Home” related items, those items will be removed after the update. ㄴ If the related items were purchased with Deco Coins, the same amount of Deco Coins will be refunded. 10. Story Formation Setting Feature - When progressing through Story Pack main quests, a Story Formation setting will be added, allowing the field formation to be composed of characters appearing in that story. ㄴ The Story Formation is field-only and is used exclusively on the field, meaning it does not affect the battle formation. - The Story Formation can be selected and changed by tapping the Field Character Settings UI at the bottom after entering a Story Pack. - Characters in the Story Formation will not be affected by HP damage caused by field traps or similar elements. ㄴ If HP is restored by a pot while using the Story Formation, the characters in the battle formation will be healed instead. - When entering a Story Pack for the first time, it will be automatically set to “Story Formation.” ㄴ After completing all main quests of that Story Pack across all difficulties, the formation will switch to the current battle formation, and the “Story Formation” tab in the Field Character Settings will be disabled. - In Content Packs, Character Packs, and Event Packs, only “Current Battle Formation” or “Custom Setting” can be selected. 11. Quality of Life Improvements 1) One-Tap Upgrade for Potential, Engraving/Awakening - A feature will be added that allows unlocking all Potentials at once or unlocking up to a selected Potential during Potential Liberation. ㄴ This feature will only be available if you have sufficient materials and Gold required for the selected liberation. - When clicking “Unlock All Potentials”, all Potentials can be quickly unlocked after confirming the required materials and Gold. - After selecting a desired Potential and clicking “Bulk Unlock Potential”, all required Potentials up to the selected one will be unlocked at once. - A feature will also be added that allows growing Engravings up to the maximum level or up to a selected stage. ㄴ When clicking an individual engraving, it can be upgraded up to the set level within the available materials. "- When clicking the central costume, the required growth materials for bulk Engraving and Awakening will be displayed, and clicking the “Engraving Growth” button will perform bulk Engraving and Awakening." 2) Last Hunting Ground Location Saved - When entering a hunting ground through Quick Hunt, the screen will now focus on the location where the last battle took place. - When entering the Magic Crystal Cave through Quick Hunt, it will focus on the last cave where a battle was fought. 3) In-Game Shop "Buy All Favorites" Feature Added - A Favorites and "Buy All Favorites" feature will be added to shops in Story Packs and Character Packs. - A Favorites button will be added at the top of item thumbnails in the shop, allowing you to add desired materials to your favorites. - When clicking the "Buy All Favorites" button, you can purchase all favorite materials across all packs at once. - A Favorites filter option will also be added to the item filter, allowing bulk purchase of favorite materials within the selected pack. 4) Change to Golden Colosseum Battle Skip Timing - During Golden Colosseum battles, battle skipping will become available after one character action has occurred for both you and your opponent. ㄴ In normal battles, the Battle Skip button will activate after one character action is completed. ㄴ During repeated battles, automatic battle skip and the next match will proceed after one character action is completed. * In a previous Developer Note, we mentioned that we planned to increase the recharge limit alongside the battle skip feature. However, even with skip available, increasing the recharge limit could still extend overall playtime. For that reason, we’ll decide whether to move forward only after thorough internal testing. If there are any changes, we’ll announce them in a future notice. 5) Increased Blood Cocktail Multiplier in Mirror Wars - During Mirror Wars, the max Blood Cocktail consumption multiplier will increase from 10× to 40×. * This increases the multiplier for Medal of the Fighting Spirit earned and does not affect your ranking points. 6) Improved Resume Function After Abnormal Battle Termination - If the game unexpectedly closes during a battle, you will now be able to resume the ongoing battle after reconnecting. ㄴ However, since Tower of Salvation does not support restarting from the previous turn, reconnecting after a forced shutdown will return you to Turn 1 of the battle in progress. ㄴ This feature is not supported in PvP content, Evil Castle: Tower of Pride, Symbol Monsters, or Taros Tactical Manual battles. - If the playable period for a battle has already ended, a separate popup message will appear and you will be returned to the page prior to that battle. 7) Daily Purchase Limit Changes for Torches, Cooked Rice, and Blood Cocktails - In the Charge Store, the purchase limit for Torches, Cooked Rice, and Blood Cocktails will change from 10 purchases per day to 300 purchases per month. 8) Refining Powder Purchase Limit Change in Golden Thread & Powder of Hope Shops - The monthly purchase limit for the Refining Powder item sold in the Golden Thread and Powder of Hope shops will increase from 100 purchases to 300 purchases. 12. Others - The X (formerly Twitter) shortcut button has been added at the bottom of the News/Notices page in Traditional Chinese. ㄴ When you tap the X shortcut button in the Traditional Chinese client, you can receive 100 Dias as a reward. Pickup and New Character Information 1) Shattered Dream Palette Costume and Palette's Exclusive Gear, Delineo will be available for Pickup. - Shattered Dream Palette Costume: After March 11th maintenance - Before March 25th maintenance. ※ The above details may be subject to change upon update. ※ For more detailed stats and information, please check the Collection menu in-game. ※ Shattered Dream Palette Costume will be added to the Powder of Hope Shop and Selective Draw after maintenance on March 25th.   ※ Shattered Dream Palette Costume will appear in the Safe Zone of Story Pack 20, and can be recruited as a companion using a ☆5 R. Contract. (Added: March 10, 2026, 09:06 UTC) ㄴ Companion recruitment is available after completing the Main Quest on Normal Difficulty. (Added: March 10, 2026, 09:06 UTC) 2) Delineo: After March 11th maintenance - Before March 25th maintenance. ※ The above information is based on the initial acquisition of the UR-grade Delineo. ※ For more detailed stats and information, please check the Collection menu in-game. 3) [RERUN] Robin Hood Zenith Costume and Zenith's Exclusive Gear, Rabbit Ranger will be available for Pickup. - Robin Hood Zenith Costume: After March 11th maintenance - Before April 8th maintenance. ※ For more detailed stats and information, please check the in-game Collection menu. ※ Robin Hood Zenith Costume will be added to the Powder of Hope shop after the maintenance on April 8th. 4) Rabbit Ranger : After March 11th maintenance - Before April 8th maintenance. ※ The above information is based on the initial acquisition of the UR-grade Rabbit Ranger. ※ For more detailed stats and information, please check the Collection menu in-game. 3) [RERUN] Reclaimed Destiny Sacred Justia Costume and Justia's Exclusive Gear, Mistilteinn will be available for Pickup. - Reclaimed Destiny Sacred Justia Costume : March 19th, 12:00 AM (UTC) - April 1st, 11:59 PM (UTC) ※ The Reclaimed Destiny Sacred Justia costume will be added to the Powder of Hope shop after the April 8th maintenance. Costume and Exclusive Gear Schedule - Costumes and Exclusive Gear will be added according to the schedule below. Issue Fixes - An issue where the formation screen could be seen behind the Golden Colosseum matchmaking screen at certain aspect ratios has been fixed. -  An issue where a typo appeared in New Hire Nebris’ Glutalk Story (9th encounter) has been fixed. -  An issue where the red dot would not be cleared after claiming rewards on the event page and returning to the Home screen after a mini-season event ended has been fixed. -  An issue where the red dot would not appear on the Mailbox tab when entering the mailbox immediately after claiming items delivered to the Mailbox has been fixed. -  An issue where the focus would automatically move to Team 2 when selecting Fiend Hunter Team Formation has been fixed. -  An issue where a selection highlight UI would remain in the list after setting gear via Compare in Character Details > Gear and then switching characters has been fixed. -  An issue where the description text for the “Great Catch Hunter” achievement was insufficient has been improved. -  An issue where the victory SD motion for Retired Legend Olivier, would display abnormally has been fixed. -  An issue where the weekly mission “Play a Mini-game” could be cleared incorrectly has been updated so it is cleared when you start a mini-game. -  An issue where companions could appear unchanged after refreshing the pub has been fixed. -  An issue where the 1000-Day Anniversary Eve Pass would not be delivered to the mailbox immediately has been fixed. -  An issue where achievement values could display incorrectly when entering Title Achievements immediately after Guild Raid settlement has been fixed. -  An issue where loading a preset in the Golden Colosseum would display stats including growth bonuses has been fixed. Note: Actual battles were already conducted with the correct stats without growth bonuses. -  An issue where the Sound Background Settings button would appear on mobile devices has been fixed. -  An issue where the score shown on the Tower of Salvation clear screen and the ranking board could differ has been fixed. -  An issue where the recruitable companion’s position in the pub for Story Pack 15 was incorrect has been fixed. -  An issue where Fantasia Square-related UI would remain visible when entering the Pandora Escape mini-game after entering Fantasia Square has been fixed. -  An issue where the tap area for Home Menu > Management extended into the My Room tap area has been fixed. -  An issue where treasure chest icons would not appear at the bottom of the Fantasia Square mini-map has been fixed. -  An issue where the Talent Skill quickslot button would not be disabled after manually collecting both map pickups and Glutti has been fixed. -  An issue where furniture layers could appear misaligned when placing furniture in My Room under certain conditions has been fixed. -  An issue where Morpeah’s Japanese voice in Story Pack 18, Quest 7 would play abnormally has been fixed. -  An issue where the game could crash when entering the Season Event Story on certain devices has been fixed. -  An issue where the pickup count could display incorrectly for the “Gotta Pick It Up 1” achievement has been fixed. -  An issue where colliding with Twing Glutti during field quests would count toward achievement progress has been fixed so it will no longer be counted. -  An issue where Onsen Swordfighter Blade’s voice would not play in the skill cutscene preview has been fixed. -  An issue where the reputation discount was not applied when viewing the Pack shop while your reputation was set to Good in the Fantasia Square Pack has been fixed. Thank you.

Story

Justia finally sets foot in the Night World.
Together with Liberta and Blade, who have newly joined her journey, Justia discovers a sinister exhibition hall in Taros, the land of the undead in the Night World.
Inside the hall lies hidden information about the Master of Dreams, a being that threatens both the Night World and the surface.

Story

Mamonir, the ruler of Taros who governs the undead, discovers an undead named Palette in the Primordial Swamp.
Impressed by her artistic talent, Mamonir decides to have Palette work as a painter in the exhibition hall.
Palette longs to freely express her own world through her paintings, while Mamonir seeks to keep her under control.

Abyssal Moon Shadow Tanya (Darkness)

Can you truly be trusted...?
That there exists a life that, having never been born, met only death—and became a vengeful spirit, drenched in sorrow.

writhing in excruciating pain, unaware of when or how it all began.

- In the Charge Store, the purchase limit for Torches, Cooked Rice, and Blood Cocktails will change from 10 purchases per day to 300 purchases per month.

8) Refining Powder Purchase Limit Change in Golden Thread & Powder of Hope Shops
- The monthly purchase limit for the Refining Powder item sold in the Golden Thread and Powder of Hope shops will increase from 100 purchases to 300 purchases.

12. Others

- The X (formerly Twitter) shortcut button has been added at the bottom of the News/Notices page in Traditional Chinese.
ㄴ When you tap the X shortcut button in the Traditional Chinese client, you can receive 100 Dias as a reward.

Pickup and New Character Information

1) Shattered Dream Palette Costume and Palette's Exclusive Gear, Delineo will be available for Pickup.
- Shattered Dream Palette Costume: After March 11th maintenance - Before March 25th maintenance.

※ The above details may be subject to change upon update.
※ For more detailed stats and information, please check the Collection menu in-game.
※ Shattered Dream Palette Costume will be added to the Powder of Hope Shop and Selective Draw after maintenance on March 25th.  

※ Shattered Dream Palette Costume will appear in the Safe Zone of Story Pack 20, and can be recruited as a companion using a ☆5 R. Contract. (Added: March 10, 2026, 09:06 UTC)

2) Delineo: After March 11th maintenance - Before March 25th maintenance.

en:01KWB238JS5ESMS36BS1TW5HGH.body: Full Burst RPG —BrownDust2. Routine maintenance and updates are scheduled for July 1. Please refer to the details below. ■ Maintenance Schedule: July 1, 11:50 PM (UTC) - July 2, 5:00 AM (UTC) (5 hr 10 mins) ■ Effect: Game access will be unavailable ■ Details: ‼️ [iOS] Temporary Change to Title Screen Presentation Due to App Store review guidelines and platform policies, the character presentation on the iOS title screen will be temporarily hidden after this update. This change only applies to the title screen and does not affect gameplay or access to any content. We will continue working on adjustments so that we can bring the presentation back in a future update. 1. Master Pack 1 Update - The first-person main story, 'Master Pack 1,' has been added. Story You awaken beneath an unfamiliar ceiling. As confusion sets in, a mysterious woman named Veila approaches you. Following her guidance, you begin working at the peculiar restaurant known as Glupy Diner, where your role is to collect the emotions and desires of its guests. Then one day, familiar dreams begin to stir, sending ripples through what had once been a peaceful daily life. At last, the hidden truth behind Glupy Diner starts to reveal itself... Special guests who will lead you toward an inescapable destiny begin arriving at Glupy Diner. - Master Pack 1 takes place after the events of Story Pack 20 and will be unlocked without any additional requirements. - The main members of the Night World—Justia, Blade, Liberta, and Tyr—will appear. - After clearing Episode 26, Reclaimed Destiny Sacred Justia will be distributed free to all Masters. * Please note that the skill balance of the "Temporary Companions" who join during the Main Quest may differ from the balance of "Permanent Companions" released in their official version. - We appreciate your understanding that this costume is being distributed at a later time to better align with the story of Master Pack 1. - Apostle Blade, Dark Saintess Liberta, and Starlight Guardian Tyr will be available as temporary companions during gameplay. ※ Masters who already own Reclaimed Destiny Sacred Justia will receive Golden Thread instead, and this costume will be excluded from future Character Pass rewards. 1-1. Full Voice Acting Support for Master Pack 1 - The main quests of Master Pack 1 will feature full voice acting in Korean and Japanese. - Experience the new main story set in Glupy Diner with fully voiced character dialogue. 1-2. Glupy Diner Tutorial Story Update - As the Master's setting and narrative have been refined, portions of the existing Glupy Diner tutorial story have been updated. - While the overall framework of the original tutorial remains unchanged, certain story details have been revised. - The updated Glupy Diner tutorial will be incorporated as part of the Master Pack. 2. New Animation & OST - A brand-new animation has been added to celebrate the 3rd Anniversary and the release of Master Pack 1. - You can watch the animation during the resource download process after launching the game. - The new theme song, "Into the Light," will also be released alongside it. - The full version will be added to the Home Menu BGM Player. - The full version of the animation will be available on our official YouTube channel. - Raon performs the Korean version, while Shuka Saito performs the Japanese version. 3. New Main Title Song - A new main title song, "Way of Light," has been added. - It can be enjoyed from the Title Screen and the Home Menu. - The full version will be added to the Home Menu BGM Player. - Raon performs the Korean version, while May'n performs the Japanese version. 4. Season Event "Serendipity Party" Update - Starting in July, Season Event stories will be presented as individual character stories. - On July 1, Episodes 1–6 of the pickup character Elise's personal story, "Serendipity Party," will be released as the Season Event story. - Event Period for "Serendipity Party": After the July 1 maintenance - before the July 15 maintenance - You can participate in the Serendipity Party Season Event by tapping the "Season Event" logo on the right side of the home menu. - Serendipity Party Season Event consists of the following activities: Event Story / Normal Battles / Challenge Battles / Fiend Hunter / Event Shop. - You can purchase various items at the Event Shop with event currency acquired from each content. 1) Serendipity Party Season Event Story Story Enjoying a well-earned vacation, Elise boards a luxurious cruise hosting a grand casino party. Before long, Elise falls for Michaela's characteristically smooth persuasion and ends up wearing a swimsuit from the Church of Exposure as she joins the casino party. Completely absorbed in the games, Elise strings together one victory after another. Then, she begins to notice the people around her stealing glances and whispering amongst themselves... Will Elise be able to make it through her summer vacation with her dignity intact? - Each episode unlocks sequentially as you watch them, and some episodes will be opened after a set period. 2) Serendipity Party Season Event Battle Guide - Event battles are divided into easy-to-challenge normal battles and challenging battles that require consideration of growth and strategy. - Upon entering the battle screen, you can check the recommended combat power for each stage, your current account's combat power, challenge objectives, and rewards for completing objectives. - Use the buttons at the bottom of the battle entry menu to check monster information or enter the battle. - Clearing each stage and achieving challenge objectives per battle rewards a certain amount of event currency. - Entering a battle requires AP. Free AP is charged every day at 12 AM (UTC), and you can purchase additional Paid AP with Dias in the Event Shop. - Winning a battle reduces AP by 1, and you receive rewards. If you lose or forfeit, AP is not consumed. - If you complete all challenge tasks in a particular stage, you can use the quick battle feature for that stage, instantly obtaining the rewards. - In won battle stages, you can proceed with Repeated Battles, gaining rewards with each victory. 3) Fiend Hunter Guide - The preparation period for hunting the giant monster "Octovius I (Wind)" will be opened. - You can access Fiend Hunter by tapping the "Fiend Hunter" button at the bottom of the main Season Event screen. - Fiend Hunter Hunting Preparation Period: After the July 1 maintenance - July 8, 11:59 PM (UTC). - Fiend Hunter Hunting Period: July 9, 12:00 AM (UTC) - July 15, 02:59 PM (UTC). Octovius I (Wind) Just when I thought I could finally catch my breath after the pool party, I received a report that the pool had gotten filthy. I was exhausted... but I couldn't just leave it like that, so I grabbed my cleaning gear and headed over. ...And then I saw it. Slimy... long... enormous... And swollen, as if it were absolutely furious...! ...What, I was describing the dangerous creature that showed up in the pool. Why is everyone blushing all of a sudden...? — Taylor's Eyewitness Account 4) Serendipity Party Event Shop Information - You can purchase various items at the Event Shop with event currency acquired from each content. - Key items available in the Event Shop include the following: * In addition to the above products, various items necessary for growth will be available. - The Paid AP purchased in the Event Shop will reset once the Season Event ends. Please use all remaining AP before the reset. - The Event Shop will remain open for 14 days after the Serendipity Party Season Event ends, during which you can purchase items using remaining event currency. * The End of Gamble Season Event Shop currently in progress will remain open for 14 days after the event ends. You can use any remaining event currency during this period to claim rewards. 5) Season Event Bonus Costumes - If you possess the event Costume designated for each Season Event, you can obtain additional event currency at a certain rate from specific Season Event content. - The Costumes eligible for bonuses during the season event from July 1 to July 15 are as follows: - If you own multiple costumes that grant participation bonuses, the additional event currency will be combined and rewarded based on the number of costumes owned. 5. Slice of Life - A Slice of Life story featuring the characters from the Master Pack 1 will be added. - You can view it from the Mini Season Event or the Story menu on the home screen. - Special SD illustrations will be displayed and can be used as an ID card background. 6. Nebris' Special Skin Update - A special skin, “Lucky Bikini Nebris,” which allows you to change the appearance of the Laid-back Lifeguard Nebris Costume, will be added. - The Nebris Special Skin can be purchased from the Skin tab on the right side of the Home screen. - Upon purchasing the special skin, you will additionally obtain an avatar outfit. - If you own only the special skin without the Costume, you can equip the avatar in Fantasia Square and set only the standing illustration and skill cutscenes on the Home screen. - When equipped, the skin changes the standing illustration, skill cutscenes, and SD character appearance of the original Costume, and adds new field idle motions not seen in the original character. * Special skins do not include Secret Event features. * No additional combat performance is granted. (Uses the original Costume’s skills.) - After obtaining the special skin, a “Skin” button will appear above the SD character of appropriate Costumes under Companion Tab > Costume Tab > Costume Selection (bottom). Tapping this button will open the skin change pop-up. 7. New System – Rapport - The Rapport system has been added. - You can access Rapport by tapping the Rapport button on the left side of the Home screen or the Glupy Diner screen, or the Diner Talk button on the left side of an individual companion's screen. - If you own a costume that supports Diner Talk, you can build Rapport with that costume. 1) Diner Talk - Diner Talk is a feature that allows you to increase a costume's Rapport Level by having a conversation with that costume. - You can participate in Diner Talks up to 3 times a day, with a limit of 1 time per day for the same costume. ㄴ Diner Talk attempts are automatically refreshed every day at 12:00 AM(UTC), and completed conversations can be viewed again in the Conversation Log. - Diner Talk is presented in a visual novel format. During each session, one unfinished conversation is randomly selected from a total of 15 conversations. ㄴ Once all conversations have been completed, any additional Diner Talk sessions will randomly select one conversation from the full list. - Choosing a response that matches the costume's preferences will grant additional Rapport. ㄴ Standard Response: +80 Rapport ㄴ Preferred Response: +100 Rapport ㄴ After completing a conversation, you can revisit it in the Conversation Log to view that costume's preferred response. - After completing 5 Diner Talk sessions with a specific costume, the Quick Diner Talk feature for that costume will be unlocked. ㄴ Quick Diner Talk allows you to skip the conversation, but you will not receive the bonus Rapport granted by selecting preferred responses. - The following costumes will support Diner Talk with the introduction of the Rapport system: ㄴ Ocean Vanguard Luvencia ㄴ Combat Medic Granhildr ㄴ Deadeye Nekyndalia ㄴ Naive Lady Elise ㄴ Dark Saintess Liberta ㄴ Apostle Blade ㄴ Night of Death Mamonir ㄴ White Cat Rou 2) Rapport Level - By participating in Diner Talk, you can increase a costume's Rapport Level. - Upon reaching Rapport Levels 10, 15, and 20, you will receive exclusive rewards. ㄴ Level 10: The Keepsake of the costume ㄴ Level 15: Rapport Costume Sticker 1 ㄴ Level 20: Rapport Costume Sticker 2 - Each costume has a Rapport Level cap. Additional Rapport Levels can be unlocked by meeting the following conditions: ㄴ Up to Level 10: Costume Acquired. ㄴ Up to Level 15: Character Awakening Complete. ㄴ Up to Level 20: Costume Potential Liberation Complete. 3) Gift - If you need additional Rapport EXP to increase a costume's Rapport Level, you can give drinks as gifts to that costume. ㄴ Gifts can be purchased from the corresponding shop using Golden Thread and Powder of Hope. - There are 7 different drink items, and each costume has its own preferred drink. - The amount of Rapport gained from each gift is as follows: ㄴStandard Gift: +20 Rapport ㄴ Preferred Gift: +40 Rapport ㄴ Special Cocktail: +150 Rapport 4) Personal Story - Each costume's Personal Story becomes available as you increase its Rapport Level. - Each Personal Story consists of 6 episodes, which are unlocked in order as your Rapport Level increases. ㄴ Episode 1: Unlocked upon obtaining the costume. ㄴ Episode 2: Rapport Level 3. ㄴ Episode 3: Rapport Level 5. ㄴ Episode 4: Rapport Level 7. ㄴ Episode 5: Rapport Level 9. ㄴ Episode 6: Rapport Level 10. 5) Rapport Buff - The Rapport Buff system is granted based on your account's cumulative Rapport Levels. - Various missions are available based on Rapport progression. Completing these missions grants buffs that increase Crit Rate. ㄴ Crit Rate gained through Rapport Buffs does not apply to temporary companions and only affects permanent companions. - Crit Rate gained through Rapport Buffs is capped at 50%. 6) Crit Rate to Crit DMG Conversion - With the addition of Rapport Buffs, a new system has been introduced that converts excess Crit Rate into Crit DMG. ㄴ Any Crit Rate exceeding 100% will be automatically converted into Crit DMG at a rate of 6% Crit DMG for every 1% excess Crit Rate. 8. New Combat Mode – The Soul-Wager - A new combat mode, The Soul-Wager, has been added. - The Soul-Wager can be accessed via Content Packs → The Soul-Wager. 1) How to Play 1-1) Introduction - The Soul-Wager is a combat mode where players place units across a 7x7 board and engage in battle. - From this screen, you can select the board you want to challenge, and each board consists of 5 to 15 stages. - When you begin a challenge, you will receive 5 lives for that board. ※ If you are defeated in a stage battle, you will lose 1 Life. If all Lives are lost, you will fail to clear the board and be returned to the lobby. 1-2) Placement Phase - During the Placement Phase, you prepare for battle by purchasing items from the Shop and placing them within your Inventory. - The Placement Phase takes place before every stage on the selected board. - At the start of each Placement Phase, you will receive Soul Tokens, the currency used to prepare for battle. - During the Placement Phase, you can preview the enemies that will appear in each stage by using the Enemy Formation Preview button. 1-3) Shop - The Shop is where you can purchase items needed for battle. - The Shop inventory can be refreshed, allowing you to browse a new selection of items. - You can purchase items using the Soul Tokens received during the Placement Phase. - The Shop always displays 4 items. Purchasing an item does not immediately restock. - You can sell items for 50% of their purchase price. - By using the Reserve Item feature, reserved items will remain available even after advancing to the next Placement Phase or refreshing the Shop. - Items are divided into Tiles, Units, and Gear Items, each serving a different purpose. - Items purchased from the Shop can be viewed in the Storage. Items kept in Storage do not provide any effects. 1-4) Inventory - The Inventory is where you place items purchased from the Shop. It consists of a 7×7 grid. - The available actions for each Inventory tile depend on whether a Floor Item or a Unit Item has been placed, as shown below. 1-5) Battle Phase - After completing the Placement Phase, tap the Start Battle button to enter the Battle Phase. - Battles are fought automatically. During battle, only observation features such as battle speed adjustment and pause are available. - A battle ends when either side's HP reaches 0. - If you tap the 'Forfeit' button, the battle will be treated as a defeat, and 1 challenge attempt will be consumed. - If the game closes unexpectedly during the Battle Phase, you can resume the battle by restarting the game and selecting Continue from the Home screen. ※ Once a battle begins, all random elements are fixed, ensuring the same battle result every time. 1-6) Endgame - If a winner is not determined within the allotted time, the battle enters the Endgame state. - While in the Endgame state, both sides continuously take damage at regular intervals, and the damage increases over time. - The Endgame state remains in effect until the battle ends. 1-7) Battle Results - If you win a battle, you can proceed to the Placement Phase of the next stage. Clearing all stages on a board grants the board clear reward. - If you lose a battle, 1 challenge attempt is consumed, and you can retry the same battle. ㄴ If you have no challenge attempts remaining, the challenge ends. 2) Reward 2-1) Alea Chips - Clearing all stages on a specific board rewards you with Alea Chips, the exclusive currency used in The Soul-Wager. - You can also earn additional Alea Chips by completing missions related to The Soul-Wager, regardless of whether you clear a board. 2-2) The Soul-Wager Shop - Use Alea Chips in the Soul-Wager Shop to purchase various rewards, including Tears of the Goddess, Gold, Refining Powder, Magic Crystals, and more. - A new season of The Soul-Wager begins every 8 weeks, and the shop is refreshed at the start of each new season. - When the shop is refreshed, purchase limits are reset, and some items may be changed. 9. New Dishes - You can obtain recipes for the new dishes by completing up to Episode 10 of the Fated Guest Story with certain costumes. - All newly added dishes are 5-Star dishes, and their ingredients are available from shops in Story Packs. - The newly added dishes and their corresponding costumes are as follows: - The additional ingredients required to prepare the new dishes are listed below and can be purchased from the Story Pack Shop. 10. Evil Castle – Tower of Desire Expansion - New 50 floors will be added to the Tower of Desire. ㄴExpanded from the previous 200 floors to 250 floors. - New achievements related to the expansion of the Tower of Desire will be added in a future update. ※ Masters who clear the expanded Tower of Desire before the achievement update will receive the related achievements and rewards retroactively. 11. Collection Improvements - Tabs have been added to Collection → Collection, allowing you to view Collection, Quest Items, and Keepsakes separately. - A filter feature has been added to Bag → Collection, allowing you to filter items by category. 12. Popularity Vote Top Characters Display in Fantasia Square - The Top 10 characters from this Popularity Vote will be displayed in Fantasia Square for 4 weeks after the voting period ends. ㄴ Each character's ranking can be checked by the number displayed beneath the character. - The Top 1 character from each season's Popularity Vote will be displayed in the Hall of Fame in Fantasia Square for 8 weeks from the start of the voting period. ㄴ The Hall of Fame can be found in front of the fishing spot in Fantasia Square. ㄴ The character who takes 1st place in this vote will be displayed in the Hall of Fame when the next vote begins. 13. Burst Added to Additional Costumes 14. Pickup and New Character Information 1) Naive Lady Elise Costume and Elise's Exclusive Gear, Rose Selection will be available for Pickup. - Naive Lady Elise Costume: After the July 1 maintenance - before the July 15 maintenance. * Resonate Stacks effects relative to the number of targets with a specific Buff or Debuff. The following are not affected by the Resonate effect: Immunity Death Time Battle Environment Effects and Domain Collection Buffs / Evil Castle’s Blessings / Artifacts Last Night Pressure Effect Unplaceable effect Gladiator’s Blessings Break effect ※ The above details may be subject to change upon update. ※ For more detailed stats and information, please check the Collection menu in-game. ※ Naive Lady Elise Costume will be added to the Powder of Hope Shop and Selective Draw after maintenance on July 15. 2) Rose Selection: After the July 1 maintenance - before the July 15 maintenance. ※ The above information is based on the initial acquisition of the UR-grade Rose Selection. ※ For more detailed stats and information, please check the Collection menu in-game. 3) [RERUN][LIMITED] Beachside Angel Teresse Costume and Teresse’s Exclusive Gear, Gravior will be available for pickup. - Beachside Angel Teresse Costume: After the July 1 maintenance - before the July 29 maintenance. ※ For more detailed stats and information, please check the Collection menu in-game. ※ Beachside Angel Teresse Costume is a limited edition Costume and will not be added to the Powder of Hope Shop or Selective Draw. * Limited Costume may be rerun at a later update. 4) Gravior: After the July 1 maintenance - before the July 29 maintenance. ※ The above information is based on the initial acquisition of the UR-grade Gravior. ※ For more detailed stats and information, please check the Collection menu in-game. 5) [RERUN] Laid-back Lifeguard Nebris Costume and Nebris's Exclusive Gear, Moon Shadow will be available for Pickup. - Laid-back Lifeguard Nebris Costume: After the July 1 maintenance - before the July 29 maintenance. ※ For more detailed stats and information, please check the Collection menu in-game. 6) Moon Shadow: After the July 1 maintenance - before the July 29 maintenance. ※ The above information is based on the initial acquisition of the UR-grade Moon Shadow. ※ For more detailed stats and information, please check the Collection menu in-game. 7) [RERUN] B-rank Idol Seir Costume and Seir's Exclusive Gear, Arch Demons will be available for Pickup. - B-rank Idol Seir Costume: After the July 1 maintenance - before the July 9 maintenance. ※ For more detailed stats and information, please check the Collection menu in-game. 8) Arch Demons: After the July 1 maintenance - before the July 9 maintenance. ※ The above information is based on the initial acquisition of the UR-grade Arch Demons. ※ For more detailed stats and information, please check the Collection menu in-game. Costume and Exclusive Gear Schedule - Costumes and Exclusive Gear will be added according to the schedule below. Other Improvements (Added on July 2, 14:14 KST) Some follow-up Fated Story content will be updated, and new collectibles will be added. ㄴYou can check the updated content through GluTalk and then claim the collectibles. Issue Fixes - Fixed an issue where NPC Liza's idle animation did not play during an NPC quest in Story Pack 3. - Fixed an issue where Granhildr's shoulder strap briefly appeared broken during the cutscene. - Fixed an issue where the "No Relics" message was not displayed when entering the Relic page in Tower of Salvation without any Relics. - Fixed an issue where an "Insufficient Quantity" popup was displayed when casting a large number of votes in the Popularity Vote. - Fixed an issue where the thumbnail for Slice of Life special scenes was incorrectly displayed as the SD scene thumbnail. - Fixed an issue where the Collection Buff icon was displayed incorrectly during battles in Evil Castle. - Fixed an issue where the character remained suspended in midair when interacting with an NPC while jumping in the Square. - Fixed an issue where characters were displayed abnormally while performing the sitting animation in the Square. - Fixed an issue where the Change Home Screen button on the right side did not function properly at 4:3 resolution on the PC client. - Fixed an issue where Relic Evasion and Skill Evasion were not being combined correctly in Tower of Salvation. - Fixed an issue where the Next button was displayed in Story Replay in Fantasia Square. - Fixed an issue where the costume order configured in a preset saved during Fiend Hunter Practice Battles was not applied when loading the preset in an actual battle. - Fixed an issue on Android where the game would crash when interacting with a Secret Event while sound was disabled. - Fixed an issue where duplicate gear appeared to be equipped when rapidly tapping the Swap button while comparing gear in the Gear Management screen. - Changed the Property of the Story Pack 19 monster "Black-Winged Valkyrie" from Light to Dark. - Fixed an issue where Rudina’s image was displayed incorrectly in the special illustration for the End of Gamble season event. Thank you.

New Combat Mode – The Soul-Wager - A new combat mode, The Soul-Wager, has been added. - The Soul-Wager can be accessed via Content Packs → The Soul-Wager. 1) How to Play 1-1) Introduction - The Soul-Wager is a combat mode where players place units across a 7x7 board and engage in battle. - From this screen, you can select the board you want to challenge, and each board consists of 5 to 15 stages. - When you begin a challenge, you will receive 5 lives for that board. ※ If you are defeated in a stage battle, you will lose 1 Life. If all Lives are lost, you will fail to clear the board and be returned to the lobby. 1-2) Placement Phase - During the Placement Phase, you prepare for battle by purchasing items from the Shop and placing them within your Inventory. - The Placement Phase takes place before every stage on the selected board. - At the start of each Placement Phase, you will receive Soul Tokens, the currency used to prepare for battle. - During the Placement Phase, you can preview the enemies that will appear in each stage by using the Enemy Formation Preview button. 1-3) Shop - The Shop is where you can purchase items needed for battle. - The Shop inventory can be refreshed, allowing you to browse a new selection of items. - You can purchase items using the Soul Tokens received during the Placement Phase. - The Shop always displays 4 items. Purchasing an item does not immediately restock. - You can sell items for 50% of their purchase price. - By using the Reserve Item feature, reserved items will remain available even after advancing to the next Placement Phase or refreshing the Shop. - Items are divided into Tiles, Units, and Gear Items, each serving a different purpose. - Items purchased from the Shop can be viewed in the Storage. Items kept in Storage do not provide any effects. 1-4) Inventory - The Inventory is where you place items purchased from the Shop. It consists of a 7×7 grid. - The available actions for each Inventory tile depend on whether a Floor Item or a Unit Item has been placed, as shown below. 1-5) Battle Phase - After completing the Placement Phase, tap the Start Battle button to enter the Battle Phase. - Battles are fought automatically. During battle, only observation features such as battle speed adjustment and pause are available. - A battle ends when either side's HP reaches 0. - If you tap the 'Forfeit' button, the battle will be treated as a defeat, and 1 challenge attempt will be consumed. - If the game closes unexpectedly during the Battle Phase, you can resume the battle by restarting the game and selecting Continue from the Home screen. ※ Once a battle begins, all random elements are fixed, ensuring the same battle result every time. 1-6) Endgame - If a winner is not determined within the allotted time, the battle enters the Endgame state. - While in the Endgame state, both sides continuously take damage at regular intervals, and the damage increases over time. - The Endgame state remains in effect until the battle ends. 1-7) Battle Results - If you win a battle, you can proceed to the Placement Phase of the next stage. - The amount of Rapport gained from each gift is as follows:
ㄴStandard Gift: +20 Rapport
ㄴ Preferred Gift: +40 Rapport
ㄴ Special Cocktail: +150 Rapport

4) Personal Story
- Each costume's Personal Story becomes available as you increase its Rapport Level.
- Each Personal Story consists of 6 episodes, which are unlocked in order as your Rapport Level increases.
ㄴ Episode 1: Unlocked upon obtaining the costume.
ㄴ Episode 2: Rapport Level 3.
ㄴ Episode 3: Rapport Level 5.
ㄴ Episode 4: Rapport Level 7.
ㄴ Episode 5: Rapport Level 9.
ㄴ Episode 6: Rapport Level 10.

5) Rapport Buff
- The Rapport Buff system is granted based on your account's cumulative Rapport Levels.
- Various missions are available based on Rapport progression. Completing these missions grants buffs that increase Crit Rate.
ㄴ Crit Rate gained through Rapport Buffs does not apply to temporary companions and only affects permanent companions.
- Crit Rate gained through Rapport Buffs is capped at 50%.

6) Crit Rate to Crit DMG Conversion
- With the addition of Rapport Buffs, a new system has been introduced that converts excess Crit Rate into Crit DMG.
ㄴ Any Crit Rate exceeding 100% will be automatically converted into Crit DMG at a rate of 6% Crit DMG for every 1% excess Crit Rate.



8. New Combat Mode – The Soul-Wager

- A new combat mode, The Soul-Wager, has been added.
- The Soul-Wager can be accessed via Content Packs → The Soul-Wager.

1) How to Play

1-1) Introduction
- The Soul-Wager is a combat mode where players place units across a 7x7 board and engage in battle.
- From this screen, you can select the board you want to challenge, and each board consists of 5 to 15 stages.
- When you begin a challenge, you will receive 5 lives for that board.
※ If you are defeated in a stage battle, you will lose 1 Life. If all Lives are lost, you will fail to clear the board and be returned to the lobby.

1-2) Placement Phase
- During the Placement Phase, you prepare for battle by purchasing items from the Shop and placing them within your Inventory.
- The Placement Phase takes place before every stage on the selected board.
- At the start of each Placement Phase, you will receive Soul Tokens, the currency used to prepare for battle.
- During the Placement Phase, you can preview the enemies that will appear in each stage by using the Enemy Formation Preview button.

1-3) Shop
- The Shop is where you can purchase items needed for battle.
- The Shop inventory can be refreshed, allowing you to browse a new selection of items.
- You can purchase items using the Soul Tokens received during the Placement Phase.
- The Shop always displays 4 items. Purchasing an item does not immediately restock.
- You can sell items for 50% of their purchase price.
- By using the Reserve Item feature, reserved items will remain available even after advancing to the next Placement Phase or refreshing the Shop.
- Items are divided into Tiles, Units, and Gear Items, each serving a different purpose.



- Items purchased from the Shop can be viewed in the Storage. Items kept in Storage do not provide any effects.

1-4) Inventory
- The Inventory is where you place items purchased from the Shop. It consists of a 7×7 grid.
- The available actions for each Inventory tile depend on whether a Floor Item or a Unit Item has been placed, as shown below.



1-5) Battle Phase
- After completing the Placement Phase, tap the Start Battle button to enter the Battle Phase.
- Battles are fought automatically. During battle, only observation features such as battle speed adjustment and pause are available.
- A battle ends when either side's HP reaches 0.
- If you tap the 'Forfeit' button, the battle will be treated as a defeat, and 1 challenge attempt will be consumed.
- If the game closes unexpectedly during the Battle Phase, you can resume the battle by restarting the game and selecting Continue from the Home screen.
※ Once a battle begins, all random elements are fixed, ensuring the same battle result every time.

1-6) Endgame
- If a winner is not determined within the allotted time, the battle enters the Endgame state.
- While in the Endgame state, both sides continuously take damage at regular intervals, and the damage increases over time.
- The Endgame state remains in effect until the battle ends.

1-7) Battle Results
- If you win a battle, you can proceed to the Placement Phase of the next stage. Clearing all stages on a board grants the board clear reward.
- If you lose a battle, 1 challenge attempt is consumed, and you can retry the same battle.
ㄴ If you have no challenge attempts remaining, the challenge ends.

2) Reward

2-1) Alea Chips
- Clearing all stages on a specific board rewards you with Alea Chips, the exclusive currency used in The Soul-Wager.
- You can also earn additional Alea Chips by completing missions related to The Soul-Wager, regardless of whether you clear a board.

2-2) The Soul-Wager Shop
- Use Alea Chips in the Soul-Wager Shop to purchase various rewards, including Tears of the Goddess, Gold, Refining Powder, Magic Crystals, and more.
- A new season of The Soul-Wager begins every 8 weeks, and the shop is refreshed at the start of each new season.
- When the shop is refreshed, purchase limits are reset, and some items may be changed.

9. New Dishes

- You can obtain recipes for the new dishes by completing up to Episode 10 of the Fated Guest Story with certain costumes.
- All newly added dishes are 5-Star dishes, and their ingredients are available from shops in Story Packs.
- The newly added dishes and their corresponding costumes are as follows:

- The additional ingredients required to prepare the new dishes are listed below and can be purchased from the Story Pack Shop.



10. Evil Castle – Tower of Desire Expansion

- New 50 floors will be added to the Tower of Desire.
ㄴExpanded from the previous 200 floors to 250 floors.
- New achievements related to the expansion of the Tower of Desire will be added in a future update.
※ Masters who clear the expanded Tower of Desire before the achievement update will receive the related achievements and rewards retroactively.

11. Collection Improvements

- Tabs have been added to Collection → Collection, allowing you to view Collection, Quest Items, and Keepsakes separately.
- A filter feature has been added to Bag → Collection, allowing you to filter items by category.

12. Popularity Vote Top Characters Display in Fantasia Square

- The Top 10 characters from this Popularity Vote will be displayed in Fantasia Square for 4 weeks after the voting period ends.
ㄴ Each character's ranking can be checked by the number displayed beneath the character.
- The Top 1 character from each season's Popularity Vote will be displayed in the Hall of Fame in Fantasia Square for 8 weeks from the start of the voting period.
ㄴ The Hall of Fame can be found in front of the fishing spot in Fantasia Square.
ㄴ The character who takes 1st place in this vote will be displayed in the Hall of Fame when the next vote begins.

en:01M0RT0GJ7GY61C935SNBZ1X58.contentPreview: Full Burst RPG —BrownDust2. Routine maintenance and updates are scheduled for August 26. Please refer to the details below. ■ Maintenance Schedule: August 26, 11:50 PM (UTC) - August 27, 5:50 AM (UTC)
en:01M0RT0GJ7GY61C935SNBZ1X58.body: Full Burst RPG —BrownDust2. Routine maintenance and updates are scheduled for August 26. Please refer to the details below. ■ Maintenance Schedule: August 26, 11:50 PM (UTC) - August 27, 5:50 AM (UTC) (6 hrs) ■ Effect: Game access will be unavailable 1. Master Pack 2 Update - Master Pack 2 'Way of the Demon' has been added. Story Following Mamonir's advice to seek out Levia, Master and Justia's group arrives at Ghenar's Colosseum. While searching for Levia in the Colosseum, Master and Justia's group discover that a map leading to the entrance of Paradise is hidden in Toire's Casino, and that the winner of Ghenar's "The Strong" Tournament will receive an invitation to Toire's Casino as a prize. Thus, Master and Justia's group enter the tournament to obtain the invitation to the casino, and Levia finally appears before them. However, when Master and Justia's group ask Levia for help, she tells them that she has no intention of helping them, and that if they want something, they should claim it themselves in the way of a demon.... - Master Pack 2 will be unlocked by clearing all the main quests of Master Pack 1. 1-1. Full Voice Acting Support for Master Pack 2 - The main quests of Master Pack 2 will feature full voice acting in Korean and Japanese. - You can enjoy the new main story in the Ghenar accompanied by the characters' voices. 2. Season Event "Untamed" Update - Six episodes of the new pickup character Aquila's personal story "Untamed" will be added after maintenance on August 26. - Event Period for "Untamed": After the August 26 maintenance - before the September 9 maintenance. - You can participate in the Untamed Season Event by tapping the "Season Event" logo on the right side of the Home Screen. - The Untamed Season Event consists of the following activities: Event Story / Normal Battles / Challenge Battles / Fiend Hunter / Event Shop. - You can purchase various items at the Event Shop with event currency acquired from each content. 1) Untamed Season Event Story Story Aquila wandered the back alleys, throwing punches to stave off the boredom of her life. One day, Aquila accidentally crippled one of Levia's slave gladiators and was imprisoned in an underground dungeon. However, Levia, who had noticed Aquila's strength, offered to make her a new slave gladiator instead of executing her. Thus, Aquila entered the competition to select the strongest as a slave gladiator, and began defeating one opponent after another who stood in her way. - Episodes unlock sequentially as you watch them. 2) Untamed Season Event Battle Guide - Event battles are divided into normal battles that are easy to challenge and challenging battles that require consideration of growth and strategy. - Upon entering the battle screen, you can check the recommended combat power for each stage, your current account's combat power, challenge objectives, and rewards for completing objectives. - Use the buttons at the bottom of the battle entry menu to check monster information or enter the battle. - Clearing each stage and achieving challenge objectives per battle rewards a certain amount of event currency. - Entering a battle requires AP. Free AP is charged every day at 12 AM (UTC), and you can purchase additional Paid AP with Dias in the Event Shop. - Winning a battle consumes 1 AP, and you receive rewards. If you lose or forfeit, AP is not consumed. - If you complete all challenge tasks in a particular stage, you can use the quick battle feature for that stage, instantly obtaining the rewards. - In cleared stages, you can initiate Repeated Battles and earn rewards with each victory. 3) Fiend Hunter Guide - The preparation period for hunting the giant monster "Chimera of Resentment (Wind)" will be opened. - You can access Fiend Hunter by tapping the "Fiend Hunter" button at the bottom of the main Season Event screen. - Fiend Hunter Hunting Preparation Period: After the August 26 maintenance - September 2, 11:59 PM (UTC). - Fiend Hunter Hunting Period: September 3, 12:00 AM (UTC) - September 9, 02:59 PM (UTC). Chimera of Resentment (Wind) A single living Fiend, yet at the same time, multiple Fiends that are slowly dying. Its true nature is that of a weaponized chimera, forcibly fused from many Fiends by Warlocks in ancient times. Every time it opens its mouth, the screams of different Fiends—each from a different species—merge into a horrifying cacophony. Where pain, resentment, and sorrow once raged, only an eternal hatred for the Warlocks who created it remains. Because of this, it howls with murderous rage at all humanoid beings, regardless of race. 4) Untamed Event Shop Information - You can purchase various items at the Event Shop with event currency acquired from each content. - Key items available in the Event Shop include the following: * In addition to the above products, various items necessary for growth will be available. - The Paid AP purchased in the Event Shop will reset once the Season Event ends. Please use all remaining AP before the reset. - The Event Shop will remain open for 14 days after the Untamed Season Event ends, during which you can purchase items using remaining event currency. * The Sunny Smile Season Event Shop currently in progress will remain open for 14 days after the event ends. You can use any remaining event currency during this period to claim rewards. 5) Season Event Bonus Costumes - If you own a designated event Costume, you can obtain additional event currency at a certain rate from specific Season Event content. - The Costumes eligible for bonuses during the Season Event from August 26 to September 9th are as follows: - If you own multiple Costumes that grant participation bonuses, the additional event currency will be combined and rewarded based on the number of Costumes owned. 3. Slice of Life - Master Pack 2 - New Slice of Life Stories featuring the Master Pack 2 characters will be added. - Discover a different side of Aquila and Levia through their new Slice of Life Stories. - You can view them from the Mini Season Event or the Story menu on the Home Screen. - Special SD illustrations will be displayed and can be used as an ID card background. 4. Blade's Special Skin Update - A special skin, “Tender Dream Blade,” which allows you to change the appearance of the Young Lady Blade Costume will be added. - The Blade Special Skin can be purchased from the Skin tab on the right side of the Home screen. - Upon purchasing the special skin, you will additionally obtain an avatar outfit. - If you own the special skin without the Costume, you can equip the avatar in Fantasia Square and set the standing illustration and skill cutscenes on the Home Screen. - When equipped, the skin changes the standing illustration, skill cutscenes, and SD character appearance of the original Costume, and adds new field idle motions not seen in the original character. * Special skins do not include Secret Event features. * No additional combat performance is granted. (Uses the original Costume’s skills.) - After obtaining the special skin, a “Skin” button will appear above the SD character of the appropriate Costumes under Companion Tab > Costume Tab > Costume Selection (bottom). Tapping this button opens the skin-change pop-up. 5. New Rapport Costume Update - After the August 26 maintenance, you will be able to begin Rapport with Savage Warrior Aquila and Night of Jealousy Levia. - Build Rapport with Savage Warrior Aquila and Night of Jealousy Levia through conversations and uncover their hidden stories. - Complete their personal story to receive heartfelt keepsakes. - We hope you enjoy the special stories they have to share. * The Rapport content is only available if you own the corresponding costume. 6. Battle Phase Presentation Added - A new Battle Phase presentation has been added with the Master Pack 2 update. - Enjoy the dynamic battles of Master Pack 2 with the new presentation. * When transitioning to a new phase, the battle starts from the allied turn following the turn in which the phase transition occurred. * The boss's buffs and debuffs do not carry over. * Death Time does not occur during phase battles against bosses. * If you abandon the battle or restart from the beginning during a phase battle, the phase will be reset, and the battle will start from the beginning. * If you continue the battle by spending Gold, retrying the battle will start from the point at which you chose to continue. 7. Practice Battle & Burst Skill Trial Features Added - A Burst Skill trial feature has been added to Practice Mode, allowing you to try out the Burst Skill of each costume. ㄴ Burst Skills are set to Stage 3 in Practice Mode, allowing you to try out Stage 3 Burst Skills even if your Costume's Burst Stage is below Stage 3. ㄴ A Practice Mode has also been added to Guild Raid. - Costumes for which Burst Skills are prohibited cannot use the Burst Skill trial feature in Practice Battles. - If you save the costume action order settings during a Practice Battle and load those settings in Normal Mode, the settings will be loaded with the highest Burst Skill stage you have acquired. 8. Burst System Improvements - An exclusive cut-in illustration is now displayed when a Burst Skill is activated, with enhanced cut-in effects depending on the Burst Stage. - Skill effects are enhanced according to the Burst Stage. ㄴ Dialogue text is displayed along with the Burst Skill cut-in, with exclusive dialogue for each Burst Stage. - Icons indicating whether a Burst Skill is being used and its Burst Stage have been added to the action order portraits. - When selecting a Burst Stage for a skill during battle, you can view the skill text with the effects of the selected Burst Stage applied. - A Burst button has been added to the Costume Info screen. By clicking each Burst Stage button, you can view the skill text with the corresponding Burst effects applied. - The Costume Enhancement Preview UI now displays skill text with the effects of each Burst Stage applied. - The effects of skills modified by Burst Skills have been improved to enable more strategic battles, including effects such as increased hit counts and expanded attack ranges. * With the Burst system improvements, all Burst Stages will be reset and the resources spent on them will be refunded. * Support Costumes registered by friends or guild members will also be removed from their respective slots. 9. Burst Skill Rebalancing - Along with the Burst system improvements, 25 Costumes with existing Burst Skills will undergo rebalancing. - Please refer to the table below for the Costumes subject to rebalancing and the changes to their Burst Skill effects. 10. Soul Wager Trial Season 2 Update - Soul Wager Trial Season 2 will be updated. - 9 new Unit pieces will be added. * Alea Chips obtained during the Soul Wager Trial Season will be removed when the regular season begins. * Please make sure to use all of your Alea Chips before the official season begins. - The cost increase interval for refreshing the Shop list will be changed. ㄴ Previous: The cost increases by 1 every 4 refreshes. ㄴ New: The cost increases by 1 every 5 refreshes. - The amount of Soul Tokens awarded for each board will be adjusted. * The amount of Soul Tokens awarded upon defeat will remain unchanged. - The balance of Unit pieces will be adjusted. - Detailed balance changes for Unit pieces will be provided in a separate notice. - The following issues in Soul Wager have been fixed. ㄴ Fixed an issue where Beachside Justice Michaela's sound was played as Overheat Levia's sound. ㄴ Fixed an issue where Masquerade Bunny Celia's sound was played as The Curse Celia's sound. ㄴ Fixed an issue where Archmage Maria's ATK increased without consuming SP. ㄴ Fixed an issue where Apostle Olivier's Invincibility activated more times than intended. ㄴ Fixed an issue where Wild Dog Luvencia could gain [Overheat], [Focus], and [Strength] without consuming SP. ㄴ Fixed an issue where White Cat Rou's effect activated whenever the cooldown elapsed, regardless of whether her attack hit the target. ㄴ Fixed an issue where Knight of Blood Justia's skill description incorrectly stated that DMG dealt increases by 1% for each Lifesteal Buff possessed. 11. Last Night Achievements and Titles Added - The maximum score for battle rewards in Last Night will be increased to 50,000,000,000 points. ㄴ Among the battle rewards, Ancient Crystal and Awakening Elixir will remain unchanged, while only the Gold rewards will be increased. - New title rewards will be added to Last Night. ㄴ A new title that can be obtained by reaching a Last Night score of 10,000,000,000 will be added. No additional Last Night titles will be added after this. - New achievements related to Last Night scores will be added. ㄴ New score-related achievements will be added beyond 7,000,000,000 points, with a total of 52 new achievement tiers being added. 12. New Mermaid, Achievement, and Stickers Added to Sky Island - A new mermaid, Blanche, will be added to Sky Island, along with the related achievement "Legend of the Skies. - Two stickers that can be obtained by completing the "Secret of the Skies" and "Legend of the Skies" achievements will be added. ㄴ All Masters who have already completed the "Secret of the Skies" achievement by successfully catching Flavia will also be able to obtain the corresponding sticker. 13. Google Play Games Service Added - Google Play Games Services will be added to the Google Play Store version. - Through this service, you can check your achievements, point progress, product information, and more. - The existing game login method will remain unchanged, and a PGS (Play Games Services) login will additionally take place when you access the game. - You can link or unlink PGS and change your account through the Google Play Games app. 14. Fantasia Square Theme Change - The theme of Fantasia Square will be changed to the default theme. 15. Burst Added to Additional Costumes 16. Pickup and New Character Information - Savage Warrior Aquila Costume and Aquila's Exclusive Gear, Blood Devourer will be available for Pickup. 1) Savage Warrior Aquila Costume: After the August 26 maintenance - before the September 9 maintenance. ※ The above details may be subject to change upon update. ※ For more detailed stats and information, please check the Collection menu in-game. ※ Savage Warrior Aquila Costume will be added to the Powder of Hope Shop and Selective Draw after maintenance on September 9. ※ Savage Warrior Aquila costume appears in the pubs of each Story Pack and the Fantasia Square Pub, and can be recruited as a companion using a ★5 R. Contract. 2) Blood Devourer : After the August 26 maintenance - before the September 9 maintenance. ※ The above information is based on the initial acquisition of the UR-grade Blood Devourer. ※ For more detailed stats and information, please check the Collection menu in-game. - [RERUN] Young Lady Blade Costume and Blade's Exclusive Gear, Blade will be available for Pickup. 3) Young Lady Blade Costume: After the August 26 maintenance - before the September 22 maintenance. ※ For more detailed stats and information, please check the Collection menu in-game. ※ Young Lady Blade Costume will be added to the Powder of Hope shop after the maintenance on September 22. 4) Blade: After the August 26 maintenance - before the September 22 maintenance. ※ The above information is based on the initial acquisition of the UR-grade Blade. ※ For more detailed stats and information, please check the Collection menu in-game. Costume and Exclusive Gear Schedule - Costumes and Exclusive Gear will be added according to the schedule below. 17. Rough Image Release - Rough images of the standing illustrations and cutscene animations for Savage Warrior Aquila and Tender Dream Blade skin have been released in the in-game News/Notices tab. ㄴ These rough images will be available in the News/Notices tab until September 1, 02:59 PM (UTC). ※ This notice contains information about new cutscenes/effects scheduled to be added after the maintenance on August 26. Please be aware of potential spoilers. Issue Fixes - Fixed an issue where the 4th Talk with Combat Medic Granhildr did not end automatically when played in Auto mode. - Fixed an issue where the Territory Pack UI was displayed when entering Pandora Escape from the Territory Pack via the Arcade. - Fixed an issue where pressing the MAX button for items without a purchase limit during Bulk Purchase set the quantity to 999. - Fixed an issue where logging continued while the tree object remained visible if a tree grew at the same time it was being chopped. - Fixed an issue where the ship from the Fishing Voyage Pack main screen was displayed when playing Pandora Escape after entering it from the Arcade via the Home screen. - Fixed an issue where parts of Helena and Venaka were cropped when minimizing Home Menu cutscenes. - Fixed an issue where the Slice of Life story for the Dragonhead Showdown did not progress at a certain point during repeated Auto/Manual playback. - Fixed an issue where some images were displayed incorrectly after exiting the Draw History screen. - Fixed an issue where certain effects were displayed incorrectly in specific situations during Forever Mascot Yuri’s Secret Event. (Added, Aug 27) Thank you.
